messages:
rachel: quick one 12 12 I was finishing a tiny Next.js + LangChain sample (agent-stub) for the starter kit and noticed auth retries behave differently in-edge vs node.
enzo: summary?
rachel: when our browser/edge bundle sees 401 it calls retry but the request sent on retry loses the Authorization header (appears to be a redirect/clone issue). node path uses a different http stack so it keeps the header and succeeds after refresh.
priya: can you paste a minimal stack or snippet?
rachel: gist: https://internal/repo/agent-stub (internal). Error: `FetchError: 401` from sdk's edge wrapper. Repro: run dev, open /play-agent, then trigger a forced token expiry (script included).
nora: likely cause: cloning Request without reattaching runtime token. Fix: rebuild Request on retry and read token from the token store.
enzo: agree. also, the starter README currently only mentions REDWOOD_API_KEY static workflow 12 we should surface ephemeral refresh flow and link to the eval harness guide so users know options.
priya: can we add a deterministic test? msw + jest.useFakeTimers + advanceTimersByTime to simulate expiry and assert the final call contains the refreshed Authorization header.
rachel: i'll add the test and a small helper in the SDK `retryWithFreshToken(req)` to centralize logic. planning PR after pairing with @priya.
enzo: add a telemetry counter `sdk.auth_retry_success` and `sdk.auth_retry_failure` so we can monitor regressions post-rollout.
rachel: noted. devex-bot: CI: e2e for PR #501 failed (snapshot for /play-agent).
priya: initial PR failed due to real timers flakiness. switched to fake timers, tests stabilized. PR #501 updated.
devex-bot: CI: PR #501 passed checks (build 7601) :white_check_mark:
rachel: merging and will post a short blurb in #devex-docs with the repro steps + snippet so other samplekits (vite/react, ssr-starter) can adopt. also adding a tiny troubleshooting section to the eval-harness README.
enzo: solid. thanks for the fast turn.
priya: leaving a code comment showing the exact reason edge clones lose headers for future readers.
rachel: thanks all :rocket:
